$comment: Sizes are world pixels (320 x 180 view). Painted files are 4x. See content/README.md. The costume was designed on 2026-09-27: see bull-leaper.md. The Minotaur's death frames were noted on 2026-10-10; in that level they are drawn in code at 1 world px, as its art is ruled (l06-minotaur/LEVEL.md, Art).

assets.what: The tourist in chapter 3's costume: a costume-shop bull-leaper kit (wig held on by a sweatband, a belt slipped to his hips, a kilt) over his running kit. Four frames: idle, walk1, walk2, jump.

The same, the wig knocked down over his eyes. Used, stretched and rotated, by the chapter's deaths, but the throne and those the Minotaur draws with frames of their own; in the Minotaur only ever turned a whole quarter, flat on his back.
Sitting on the floor with the wig off in his lap: the 'Gave up' pose.
Sitting in the throne at Knossos, facing out, at rest. The one death in the game with no physical cause.
Pasted flat on a ceiling by the Minotaur's snort, face up against it, splayed and still, the wig over his eyes. Never turned.
Caught by the throat by the Minotaur's knot, his feet flying out ahead of him, drawn tipped back at 45 degrees: the one frame between upright and flat on his back.
The jump frame, kilt flying, drawn tipped over at 45 degrees: the half-quarter of the Minotaur's somersault, turned by quarters for the other three.
Clapped flat between the Minotaur's palms like a fly: edge-on, 4 px wide.
Pressed flat, lying: on the floor where the Minotaur's clap drops him or its swat flattens him, and on its brow between the horns.
